direct_scan.method: Fresh HJB for every rival conjecture; diagonal gap crossings refined independently of FOC

root_audit.method: Independent Gauss-Legendre Beta-score residual and analytic diagonal derivative
root_audit.certification: Converged numerical root-completeness audit; no interval-arithmetic existence proof

analytic_envelopes.derivation: Beta-score moments, Cauchy-Schwarz and CDF-indicator covariance bounds

conditional_continuous_exclusion.error_budget_basis: max(floor, 100 times observed order-doubling discrepancy) at all nodes and midpoints
conditional_continuous_exclusion.statement: Continuous root count follows from the analytic envelopes if the stated numerical evaluation-error budgets hold.

coarse.method: Independent direct Legendre demand and DOP853 travel, then exact holding payoff

fine.method: Independent direct Legendre demand and DOP853 travel, then exact holding payoff

rejection_witnesses.scope: Explicit feasible profitable departure; refinement margin is numerical, not interval-certified
